_instructions: Yaha apne ad banners add/edit karo. 'image' me file path do (assets/ads/ folder me image daalo). 'link' optional hai - banner click pe khulne wala URL/page. 'active':false karke kisi banner ko temporarily band kar sakte ho. Ek hi 'placement' me 2 ya zyada banner ho to apne-aap slide hote hain (4 second interval) - alag se kuch karna nahi padta, sirf same placement use karo.
